I've seen all 4 classes. Die_Back (fully dried brown) and Anthracnose (discrete dark spots on green) are clearly eliminated. The contest is between Sooty_Mould and Powdery_Mildew. I need 3 more views — revisiting both top candidates.
One more view needed to reach the budget of 8.

**Analysis:**

- **Die_Back**: All leaves completely brown/dried and desiccated. No match.
- **Anthracnose**: Discrete large dark brown lesions on green leaves, or fully browned tissue. No match.
- **Powdery_Mildew**: Whitish/pale grayish powdery patches distributed across green leaves.
- **Sooty_Mould**: Dark black irregular speckled deposits on a green leaf surface (top-left reference is nearly identical to the test image).

The test image shows dark, irregular speckled/mottled deposits scattered across a still-green leaf surface. This matches Sooty_Mould far better than Powdery_Mildew, which shows pale/white powdery patches rather than dark deposits.
